purpose: Mechanism qualification only; these cases are already consumed and are excluded from future generalization estimates.

selection.source: The first three completed pairs in the pre-existing fixed Hard6 path-parity batch.
selection.rationale: Conan is a V4 efficiency win, PyRollbar is a severe replay-amplification loss, and LangGraph is a mixed token/wall-time result. This avoids testing only cases where the new treatment is expected to look favorable.

comparison.pairing: Both arms use the same case, model, provider order, seed, image, public goal, evaluator, host lane, and broad safety limits.
comparison.arm_order: Alternates B/V5, V5/B, B/V5 across the three pairs.

primary_endpoint: Official EnvBench Pass@1; success is assessed before resources.
mechanism_endpoints: frontier observation occurs after declared changes
verified resolved, introduced, and stagnant obligation counts with model-view truncation explicitly audited
whether a frontier delta changes the next Agent operation
recovery after a misleading zero exit or partially successful nonzero change
same-session repair after clean replay failure
final program path portability and deployment completeness
adjudication: A treatment success loss rejects V5 as the next core method. With tied success, trajectory evidence must show operation-attributable recovery or clearer state diagnosis; projection truncation and resource use then decide whether the mechanism merits repository-disjoint development qualification. Tokens are a reported metric, not a success-stopping threshold.
